summary: This directory centralizes the definition and management of domain-specific errors for the application. It provides structured error classes and context interfaces to ensure consistent error handling, debugging, and diagnostics across different service operations.
responsibilities: Define specialized error classes for specific operational failure modes
Provide diagnostic context for troubleshooting and error analysis
Categorize errors by lifecycle phase and retryability
relationships: Error classes encapsulate error context interfaces to provide structured metadata during an application failure.
The operation lifecycle phase helps define the context in which a specific error occurs.
designDecisions: Use of specialized context interfaces for each error type to enforce type-safe error metadata
Separation of concerns by creating dedicated error classes for distinct failure domains like AI providers and routing
